preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 58 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i <= n and 1 <= r_i <= n for b_i, r_i in arcs)
preconditions.description: Each blue and red arc destination is between 1 and n inclusive.
The number of queries q is between 1 and 5000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v < n for v, s in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query vertex v is between 1 and n-1 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n - 1 and all(c in 'RB' for c in s) for v, s in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query string s has length n-1 and consists only of 'R' and 'B'.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
all(result == -1 or result >= 0 for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result is either -1 or a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(result == -1 or result <= 2**(n-1) for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each reachable result is at most 2^(n-1) seconds.
